theorem.statement: If S(t)=(t/2)Q_ζ(f_t) holds for (mollified) top-hats f_t with support width t≤2.6, AND if the mollified family stays inside the certified Weil class (or the identity extends by density/dominated convergence to the L² top-hat), THEN S(t) ≥ (t/2)·c·‖f_t‖² for t∈(0,2.6], with c the certified coercivity constant.
theorem.mollification_caveat: S40 CONFIRMED-with-caveat: top-hat is square-integrable but not Schwartz/smooth. Mollify; sinc²(r)·log(2+|r|) integrable ⇒ dominated convergence for Arch/gamma integral; prime sum finite. Schwartz-only statement of Weil criterion = mild GAP for bare top-hat.

verdict.label: CONFIRMED-with-GAP
verdict.what_is_confirmed: IF the top-hat identity S=(t/2)Q extends to mollified top-hats with support in [-1.3,1.3] AND those mollifiers lie in (or are limits of) the certified coercivity class, THEN S(t)≥(t/2)c>0 on (0,2.6] with c≥3.634e-62 (S36) or c≥4.26e-62 (S38). Ideal numerical floor at t=2.6: S≥1.3·c ≈ 4.7e−62 (S36) / 5.5e−62 (S38).
verdict.what_is_NOT_certified: S41 does NOT claim CERTIFIED S(t)>0 on (0,2.6] from the Weil window alone. Mollification + Galerkin-density / projection-loss remain GAPs.
gaps: GAP: bare L² top-hat is not in the Schwartz/smooth test class of the     classical Weil criterion; S40 mollify caveat stands.

GAP: certified S36/S38 class is a specific finite Galerkin window     (T,K,ng,...), not all of C_c^∞([-1.3,1.3]). Extension of Q≥c‖f‖²     from the Galerkin subspace to mollified top-hats is unproved here.
GAP: no explicit projection-loss bound ‖(1-P)f_t‖² computed in S41.
OPEN: kick/U+ barrier for t>2.6; this bridge only addresses small-t mass.
verdict.dead_end_avoided: DEAD END: claiming bare top-hat ∈ Schwartz / cert class without mollify.
